title: The Girl Named Esther
subtitle: When My Angel Entered My Life
quote: Sometimes, God doesn't answer your prayers with words. He answers them by introducing someone into your life.
endQuote: Sometimes, one introduction is enough to change an entire lifetime. I met many people in college, but only one became the reason my heart learned a new meaning of happiness. That evening, I met Esther. I didn't know it then—but I had just met the most beautiful chapter of my life.

content.text: That evening was supposed to be just another ordinary day.

The sun was slowly disappearing behind the university buildings, painting the sky with shades of orange and gold. The campus was calm. Students were walking back to their hostels after a long day of classes and club activities.
I never imagined that this peaceful evening would become the most unforgettable moment of my life.
As my friends and I walked through the shortcut, we noticed my friend Bhagavath standing nearby.
He was talking to three junior girls.
Bhagavath was the kind of person who could talk endlessly. Usually, if he started a conversation, it would last forever. I honestly thought we would just greet him and continue walking.
The moment he saw me, he smiled and called out,
I still don't know why he called me.
Maybe it was just a casual invitation.
As I walked closer, Bhagavath looked at the three girls standing beside him.

content.speaker: Bhagavath
content.text: Hari... these three are our juniors.
Then he began introducing them one by one.
He pointed towards the first girl.
Then he pointed towards the second girl.
He turned towards the third girl.
She was standing slightly away from us, talking on her phone.
The moment I heard that name...
I don't know how to explain what I felt.
It wasn't something I had planned.
It wasn't love at first sight.
A feeling I had never experienced before.
As she looked in our direction, it felt as though the entire world had gone silent.
The voices around me faded away.
Even the evening breeze seemed to stop for a second.
Only one person remained in my world.
There are thousands of students on a university campus.
She was the only person I could see.
My heart quietly asked a question.
Bhagavath answered without even realizing what was happening inside me.
I repeated that name silently in my heart.
There was something beautiful about it.
It was the grace she carried.
The simplicity in the way she stood.
Yet everything about that moment felt extraordinary to me.
We didn't even exchange a single word.
That brief moment left a mark on my heart.
After a few minutes, we said goodbye and continued walking.
My friends continued talking about random things.
But I wasn't really listening anymore.
My body was walking with them...
But my mind had stayed behind.
I couldn't understand why I kept thinking about her.
"Why am I remembering someone I met for barely a minute?"
"Why does her face keep appearing in my mind?"
It was the beginning of a story that neither of us knew we were about to write.
As I reached my hostel room that night, I smiled to myself.
But the girl I had just met...
Would one day become the person who would change me completely.
The person I would later call... "My Angel."
